title: How to get the Korean MMORPG UI artstyle? I tried buying assets  made from artstis and convert with AI them but they look like shit
author: NotSharingData
selftext:
Everything sold in asset stores is either something for WoW clones or Path of Exile clones or some shitty blocky or pixel stuff...



how do I get the classic korean mmorpg ui ? literally no one sells it, I tried even looking in korean websites but couldn't find anything, korean artsits don't sell their assets, they only showcase them, korean mmos use teams that made the assets for each specific game, and since there aren't that many devs or artists there every game ends up being made by the same people more or less.

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: Feed it games u like the UI. Then tell you to make 4 to 6 mock ups of the UI. Then you can tell it to go again and change the genre. From there you tell you like x one make it big then you tell if you want each of the assets on a solid background. Then choppy choppy in photospea, ps, gimp etc.
